title: Aquatic Invasive Species
cross_references: NWCG Invasive Species Subcommittee Guide to Preventing Aquatic Invasive Species Transport by Wildland Fire Operations, PMS 444

nodes.text: Minimize potential transmission of aquatic invasive species

evidence.source_text: To minimize potential transmission of aquatic invasive species, it is recommended that you:

nodes.text: Consult with local resources, biologists, READ/Fs about known aquatic invasive species locations

evidence.source_text: Consult with local resources, biologists, READ/Fs about known aquatic invasive species locations.

nodes.text: Draft/fill tanks from municipal or treated water sources when possible

evidence.source_text: Draft/fill tanks from municipal or treated water sources when possible.

nodes.text: Avoid transfers of water between drainages/unconnected waters

evidence.source_text: Avoid transfers of water between drainages/unconnected waters.

nodes.text: When drafting, avoid sucking organic and bottom material from a water source

evidence.source_text: When drafting, avoid sucking organic and bottom material from a water source.

nodes.text: Use single water source if possible. Allow time for equipment decontamination/drying

evidence.source_text: Use single water source if possible. Allow time for equipment decontamination/drying.

nodes.text: Remove all organic material/mud from equipment/gear external surfaces when possible

evidence.source_text: Remove all organic material/mud from equipment/gear external surfaces when possible.

nodes.text: Carry spare, clean, dry helicopter buckets, draft hoses, and foot valves to switch out with used ones when moving to a new water source

evidence.source_text: Carry spare, clean, dry helicopter buckets, draft hoses, and foot valves to switch out with used ones when moving to a new water source.

nodes.text: Decontaminate/dry the wet gear while spares are being used

evidence.source_text: Decontaminate/dry the wet gear while spares are being used.

nodes.text: Adhere to corrosion requirements for aluminum on aircraft fuselages or water delivery components when using chemicals

evidence.source_text: Adhere to corrosion requirements for aluminum on aircraft fuselages or water delivery components such as helicopter buckets and foot valves when using chemicals.
If gear contacts untreated water, decontaminate gear before moving to new drainages.

nodes.text: Decontaminate gear before moving to new drainages

evidence.source_text: If gear contacts untreated water, decontaminate gear before moving to new drainages.

nodes.text: Water delivery equipment and accessories that do not transfer tank water to waterbodies do not need to be disinfected

evidence.source_text: Water delivery equipment and accessories that do not transfer tank water to waterbodies do not need to be disinfected (e.g., fireline hoses, wye valves, nozzles).

nodes.text: Refer to NWCG Invasive Species Subcommittee Guide or local area/agency direction for further guidance

evidence.source_text: For further direction refer to NWCG Invasive Species Subcommittee Guide to Preventing Aquatic Invasive Species Transport by Wildland Fire Operations, PMS 444, or local area or agency direction.
